scope: Collaborative synthetic-data academic healthcare operations workstream; no model execution or real clinical deployment claimed.

baseline.task: Three-class low/normal/high room-utilization state at future horizons
baseline.target_definition: Per-synthetic-system utilization below full-series Q25, above full-series Q75, otherwise normal.
baseline.split_in_actual_code: Random stratified 80/20 row split; the time-safe source comment is inaccurate.
other_limits: Rooms use system plus room number rather than hospital-qualified room IDs.
Longer-horizon summary plots use manually entered historical metric arrays.

refined.task: Predict future artificial-coalition high-utilization proxy labels at 1 through 7 days ahead.
refined.capacity_proxy: ceil(full-series 95th percentile of occupied rooms / 0.85), with minimum 20; not an observed staffing measurement.
refined.high_label_definition: Utilization ratio greater than or equal to 0.85 (code uses >=).
refined.split_in_source: Earliest 70%, validation next 10%, latest 20% within each coalition.
refined.review_rule: Maximum of GBM and SVM positive-class probability crosses the per-horizon threshold.
refined.runtime_completeness: review_lock_by_horizon_df is referenced but never defined in the supplied refined script. Clean top-to-bottom replay is not established.

critical_method_limits: Synthetic records and artificially balanced hospital coalitions do not establish real hospital demand, capacity or staffing behavior.
Capacity calibration and coalition assignment use the complete time range before partitions, so held-out information influences the problem definition.
Some shifted rolling histories are computed on a plain Series after grouping for shift, which allows window carry-over across coalition boundaries.
No horizon-sized gap purges train/validation/test boundary rows whose shifted targets cross those boundaries.
The daily series is created from occupied-room rows without an explicit all-coalition/all-date reindex; row shifts should not be assumed to prove exact calendar-day horizons for every row.
Only 29 positive held-out rows per final horizon, low precision and sparse validation positives limit interpretation.
The supplied refined source depends on missing interactive threshold-lock state; saved outputs are historical evidence, not a newly reproduced evaluation.
Original actionability and safety wording is retained only in historical figure content; the portfolio does not validate those claims.
supported_skill_evidence: Static source review and reproducibility assessment
